a.lede: The charges against the Chinese tech company date back to 2019.
a.title: Huawei is guilty of conspiracy to steal trade secrets, US jury rules

b.lede: A jury found Huawei guilty on 10 out of 12 counts, although it was acquitted of racketeering and conspiracy to obstruct justice.
b.title: Huawei convicted of money laundering, conspiracy to steal trade secrets, and fraud by US jury
